style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render set in an empty pure white space. People are smooth faceless figurines with no eyes, nose or mouth details, told apart only by clothes, hairstyle and props. Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle looking down. Mostly white and light gray colors; only the key objects (the balloons) are red. The setting is Cleveland, Ohio, USA, on the shore of Lake Erie, in 1986.
avoid_en: logos, emblems, badges or patches of real companies, groups, agencies or the coast guard, any readable text, letters or numbers anywhere (all signs, papers, screens, boats and shirts are blank), national flags, blood, injuries, faces resembling real people, split panels or comic frames

staff.desc_en: the organizer, a faceless man figurine in his thirties with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short curly brown hair, plain red windbreaker without any print, khaki trousers, white sneakers

students.desc_en: teenage volunteer figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details), plain white t-shirts without any print, blue jeans, various short hairstyles

fishers.desc_en: two faceless middle-aged man figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details): one in a plain yellow raincoat and plain gray cap, the other in a plain orange raincoat and plain dark-blue cap, both in dark trousers and rubber boots

guard.desc_en: rescue crew figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details), plain navy jackets with no patches or badges, orange life vests with no text, dark trousers

cuts.image_en: Inside a small plain lakeside office diorama, the older faceless man figurine with short gray hair in a plain navy jacket with no patches stands at a window, looking out at the gray lake. A plain desk with blank papers. No text or emblems.
cuts.en: Inside a small plain lakeside office diorama, the older faceless man figurine with short gray hair in a plain navy jacket with no patches stands at a window, looking out at the gray lake. A plain desk with blank papers. No text or emblems.

cuts.image: 古い新聞社の机で、眼鏡の男のフィギュアが原稿を書いている（文字は読めない）
cuts.image_en: At a newspaper office desk diorama, a faceless man figurine with glasses and a plain white shirt types on an old typewriter. Blank papers pile around him. No readable text.
cuts.en: At a newspaper office desk diorama, a faceless man figurine with glasses and a plain white shirt types on an old typewriter. Blank papers pile around him. No readable text.

cuts.image: 昼の湖。防波堤のそばの水面が赤と白の風船でおおわれている（F07 の前の絵）
cuts.image_en: Daytime view of a gray lake by a stone breakwall, its surface covered by floating red and white balloons. Overcast sky. No boat, no people.
cuts.en: Daytime view of a gray lake by a stone breakwall, its surface covered by floating red and white balloons. Overcast sky. No boat, no people.

cuts.image: 嵐の夜の同じ湖。風船は1つも無く、空っぽのボートだけが波に揺れている（前の絵 F07a から切り替える）
cuts.image_en: The same gray lake by the stone breakwall, but at night in a storm: no balloons at all, high dark waves, and only the small empty wooden fishing boat tossed on the water. Cold blue light, heavy rain.
cuts.en: The same gray lake by the stone breakwall, but at night in a storm: no balloons at all, high dark waves, and only the small empty wooden fishing boat tossed on the water. Cold blue light, heavy rain.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、針の無い時計の模型
cuts.image_en: In the white space, a plain round clock model with no hands and no numbers on its face, under a dim spotlight. Mysterious mood.
cuts.en: In the white space, a plain round clock model with no hands and no numbers on its face, under a dim spotlight. Mysterious mood.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、赤い風船の模型と空のボートの模型が、赤い糸で結ばれている
cuts.image_en: In the white space, a red balloon model and a small empty boat model sit apart on the floor, tied together by one long red thread stretched between them.
cuts.en: In the white space, a red balloon model and a small empty boat model sit apart on the floor, tied together by one long red thread stretched between them.

cuts.image: 白い台の上に、厚い本の模型が開いている。ページの上に小さな赤い風船（文字は読めない）
cuts.image_en: On a white stand, a thick open record book model with blank pages and no readable text. A tiny red balloon floats just above the open pages. Spotlight.
cuts.en: On a white stand, a thick open record book model with blank pages and no readable text. A tiny red balloon floats just above the open pages. Spotlight.

cuts.image: 白い台座の上のトロフィーに、灰色の布がかけられている
cuts.image_en: On a white pedestal, the gold trophy model is now covered with a plain gray cloth. The red balloon that was tied to it lies deflated at the base.
cuts.en: On a white pedestal, the gold trophy model is now covered with a plain gray cloth. The red balloon that was tied to it lies deflated at the base.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、からっぽの透明の募金箱と、赤い下向きの矢印の模型
cuts.image_en: In the white space, the big transparent donation box model is now empty. Next to it, a large red arrow model points downward. No text.
cuts.en: In the white space, the big transparent donation box model is now empty. Next to it, a large red arrow model points downward. No text.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、赤い風船の模型と、その前に大きな赤い×印
cuts.image_en: In the white space, a single red balloon model stands on a short string, and in front of it a big flat red X mark model stands upright. Clean, simple composition.
cuts.en: In the white space, a single red balloon model stands on a short string, and in front of it a big flat red X mark model stands upright. Clean, simple composition.

cuts.image: 灰色の岸で、ごみ袋を持ったフィギュアたちが、しぼんだ赤い風船を拾っている
cuts.image_en: On a gray rocky lakeshore diorama, a few faceless figurines in plain gray jackets pick up deflated red and white balloons and put them into plain gray trash bags. Overcast, quiet mood.
cuts.en: On a gray rocky lakeshore diorama, a few faceless figurines in plain gray jackets pick up deflated red and white balloons and put them into plain gray trash bags. Overcast, quiet mood.

cuts.image: 子どもと高校生のフィギュアが、1つの赤い風船を手放す瞬間
cuts.image_en: A small child figurine and a teenage figurine in a plain white t-shirt stand together on the white floor, both just letting go of one red balloon that starts to rise. Gentle, hopeful mood.
cuts.en: A small child figurine and a teenage figurine in a plain white t-shirt stand together on the white floor, both just letting go of one red balloon that starts to rise. Gentle, hopeful mood.

cuts.image: 遠い畑の模型に、しぼんだ赤い風船が1つだけ落ちている
cuts.image_en: A wide quiet farm field diorama far from any city. In the middle of the field, one single deflated red balloon lies on the grass with its string. Soft light, lonely mood.
cuts.en: A wide quiet farm field diorama far from any city. In the middle of the field, one single deflated red balloon lies on the grass with its string. Soft light, lonely mood.
